Class PlexModuleFile

java.lang.Object
dev.plex.module.PlexModuleFile
public final class PlexModuleFile extends Object
Information read from a module's module.yml file. A module name can contain letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens. Its maximum length is 64 characters.
